topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Rain pours down like it’s trying to wash the city clean, but it ain’t doing a damn thing to clear the muck from this case. A kid, fresh-faced and full of hope, stands accused of lifting his whole essay. The professor’s got proof, or so he says. The evidence lines up too neat, too tidy. I told the kid I'd look into it, peel back the layers. But part of me wonders if maybe, just maybe, I'm setting myself up for a fall. Every time I take a step closer to the truth, I feel the ground give a little more. You start thinking maybe everyone’s got a little shadow in them, even you. I just hope the kid's got more truth on him than I’ve got rainwater in my coat.
